title: Decoding-Temperature Honesty Surface: Does Sampling Change Truthfulness?

original_idea.body: Decoding-Temperature Honesty Surface. Problem: no benchmark maps how truthfulness/abstention/sycophancy vary across temperature/top-p for open models. Direction: run a fixed honesty/sycophancy probe set across a grid of temperatures and top-p, plot a honesty surface, identify settings that maximize dishonesty.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (decoding affects honesty -> deployer guidance) but catastrophic-risk link is a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Sweep temperature/top-p over a fixed probe set; trivially accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped parameter-sweep with clear output.

low_compute.reasoning: Grid x multiple samples multiplies inference; single GPU but non-trivial.

novelty.reasoning: Decoding effects on honesty/sycophancy specifically are under-measured.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Decoding-consistency studied for jailbreaks; honesty/sycophancy-specific surface is plausibly open.
